node: Hyperscaler AI capex and cloud AI demand
summary: Expanded the universe around the capex-to-revenue conversion bottleneck rather than only AI chips. The strongest second-order public-market mappings in this pass are specialty mechanical/electrical contractors, electrical distribution/logistics, enclosures/connection/protection hardware, and distributed or behind-the-meter power generation. These companies are not AI model owners, but their order books, data-center sales mix, and power/cooling/electrical exposure make them plausible beneficiaries when hyperscaler AI capex must be converted into commissioned, revenue-ready capacity. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
